2.211.13
MapColorScale.MapLocation
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.MapLocation element specifies the location of a MapColorScale. This element is
optional. If this element is present, the MapColorScale.Position element is ignored. This element is of
type MapLocation.
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.MapLocation element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.MapLocation element.
 <xsd:element name="MapLocation" type="MapLocationType" minOccurs="0" />
